legend_note: Hover over a light to see its reason and basis.

legend_hint.ok: Compliant: computed, within the limit or target values
legend_hint.warn: To review: less than 5 dB reserve or up to 125 % of the quota
legend_hint.over: Exceeded: limit or 125 % of the quota exceeded
legend_hint.incomplete: Not assessable: usages without a source or level in the state (O8)
legend_hint.none: No data: no calculation basis or no usages recorded
